text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion took her Trainer out into the 
city! She thoroughly enjoys experiencing 
life as a normal student...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before long, she begins to talk about her 
position. Her gratitude for being raised 
with such care, and that she had never 
once thought of running away from her 
duties. That is becauseâ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Because becoming the cornerstone of my 
homeland's prosperity is my mission"―― 
Fine Motion stated with absolute 
conviction.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Being in Japan right now is also meant to 
serve as a 'foundation.' Her Trainer 
wished to show her the view from even 
greater heights through racing.
